title: Three dead and 15 injured in Tenerife tidal surge
summary: Emergency services have warned tourists and locals to keep away from coastal paths due to rough sea conditions.

title: Travellers warned US flights could be 'reduced to a trickle'
summary: Secretary Sean Duffy said on Sunday that more air traffic reductions are coming if the US government shutdown, which is now on day 40, continues.

title: Apple reportedly plans ambitious satellite-powered iPhone features
summary: While Apple’s iPhone already supports texting, calling emergency services, and contacting roadside assistance via satellite connectivity, the company may have many more satellite-powered features in the works.

title: Ex-Central Bank Director Sworn In as Bolivia’s Finance Minister
summary: Former central bank director and economist José Gabriel Espinoza was sworn in Sunday as Bolivia’s new finance minister, tasked with stabilizing an economy battered by rampant inflation, shortages, and dwindling foreign reserves.

title: Holed-Up Hamas Fighters Test Future of Gaza Peace Plan
summary: As many as 200 Hamas fighters holed up in an Israeli-held area of the Gaza Strip and defying calls to surrender are casting doubts on the implementation of President Donald Trump’s peace plan.
